'''Malory Lands''' was the cousin of [[Roan Lands]], one of the founding members of the resistance group [[The Eleven]] on [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]. She was the daughter of Roan's Aunt Lilia. Malory was a med student at [[ChanPal]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] until the Empire took control renaming it [[Emperor's Reconstructive Surgical Center]], and she returned to her home world of [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]. It was there that she reunited with her cousin's best friend, [[Ferus Olin]] at the [[Nine Days of Mourning]] being held for Roan. It was at this meeting that [[Ferus Olin]] asked her to return to her former school in an attempt to uncover information about the true identity of his nemisis, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], in effect enrolling her in the ranks of [[The Eleven]].
